description: NaGaSiO₄ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃ space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent GaO₄ tetrahedra and corners with six equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.50 Å) and three longer (2.63 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.45 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.33 Å) and three longer (2.57 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ga is bonded to four O atoms to form GaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 58-78°. There are three shorter (1.85 Å) and one longer (1.86 Å) Ga-O bond length. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent GaO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 58-64°. There are two shorter (1.64 Å) and two longer (1.65 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ga, and one Si atom.
